description: core's HUD shell corpus (conformance/ui/compass-cases.json, P2.core) through the ui.compass.* rows, each op the calls core's reference runner (src/ui/hud-corpus.ts) makes, through them; numbers held exactly (the corpus's tolerance is 1e-9; tests/ui_hud_corpus.cpp replays the file itself within it).

cases.name: ui-compass: the contract ui.compass.contract states
ui-compass view: facing north with north at +Z is heading 0, N
ui-compass view: a quarter turn toward +X is heading 90, E
ui-compass view: facing -Z is heading 180, S
ui-compass view: a negative yaw wraps: -90 is heading 270, W
ui-compass view: more than a turn wraps: 450 is heading 90
ui-compass view: north is an input: with north at +X, facing +X is heading 0
ui-compass view: with north at +X, facing +Z is heading 270, W
ui-compass view: with north at -Z, facing +X is heading 270, W
ui-compass view: heading 30 rounds to NE; the default span is stated
ui-compass view: marker bearings are measured from the subject: ahead, right, behind, left, and the diagonals
ui-compass view: relative bearing wraps across north (facing 350, a marker at bearing 10 is 20 to the right)
ui-compass view: a marker straight behind is +180, never -180
ui-compass view: a marker on the subject has a distance of 0 and no bearing
ui-compass view: bearings follow north, not the facing alone
ui-compass view: a span of 360 shows every marker; behind is the right-hand edge
ui-compass view: a narrower span hides what a wider one shows
ui-compass view: kind and label are carried through; absent ones stay absent; the input order is kept
ui-compass view: no markers is an empty list
ui-compass view: refused: a non-finite yaw (null in JSON)
ui-compass view: refused: a non-finite northYaw
ui-compass view: refusal order: yaw before northYaw
ui-compass view: a span of null reads as absent: the default span, not a non-finite one
ui-compass view: refused: a span of 0
ui-compass view: refused: a span over 360
ui-compass view: refused: a negative span
ui-compass view: refused: a non-finite position
ui-compass view: refusal order: span before position
ui-compass view: mirrored: op view takes it too; facing +Z with north at +Z, a marker at +X is on the strip's left
ui-compass view: refused: a mirrored that is not a boolean
ui-compass view: refusal order: the span's range before mirrored
ui-compass view: refusal order: mirrored before position
ui-compass view: refused: the first marker with a non-finite position, by index
ui-compass heading: heading: yaw less north, in degrees
ui-compass heading: heading: a tiny negative wraps to 0, never 360
ui-compass heading: heading: exactly a full turn is 0
ui-compass cardinal: cardinal: 0 degrees
ui-compass cardinal: cardinal: 22.4 degrees
ui-compass cardinal: cardinal: 22.5 degrees
ui-compass cardinal: cardinal: 67.5 degrees

ui-compass cardinal: cardinal: 157.5 degrees

ui-compass cardinal: cardinal: 337.4 degrees
ui-compass cardinal: cardinal: 337.5 degrees
ui-compass cardinal: cardinal: 359.9 degrees
ui-compass cardinal: cardinal: -45 degrees
ui-compass cardinal: cardinal: 405 degrees
ui-compass north: north: a world with no geography gets the declared default, +Z
ui-compass north: north: a null geography states nothing: the default
ui-compass north: north: a geography with no georeference states nothing: the default
ui-compass north: north: a georeference with no rotation states north at +Z, from the world
ui-compass north: north: a georeference turned 90 degrees counter-clockwise puts north at +X
ui-compass north: north: a clockwise turn is a negative yaw, kept as stated (not wrapped)
ui-compass north: north: a local frame states north the same way
ui-compass north: north: refused, a non-finite rotation
ui-compass world_view: world: no geography, facing +Z is N; a marker at +X is due east
ui-compass world_view: world: the georeference states the north: turned 90, facing +Z is W and +X is N
ui-compass world_view: world: an unturned georeference agrees with the default but says it is stated
ui-compass world_view: world: a facing direction instead of a yaw: +X is E
ui-compass world_view: world: a facing need not be a unit vector
ui-compass world_view: mirrored level (X=x, Y=z): an Unreal yaw of 0 faces the IR +x, heading 90, E (yaw less a fixed north says 270, W)
ui-compass world_view: mirrored level: an Unreal yaw of 90 faces the IR +z, heading 0, N
ui-compass world_view: mirrored level: an Unreal yaw of 30 is heading 60 (the mirror reverses the turn; the strip is mirrored with it)
ui-compass world_view: mirrored level: an Unreal yaw of -120 is heading 210, SW
ui-compass world_view: mirrored level: facing north, a marker at the level's +X (east, on the player's left) is on the strip's left
ui-compass world_view: mirrored level: facing north, the labels run N W S E clockwise (W on the right, E on the left, S behind)
ui-compass world_view: mirrored level: an Unreal yaw of 30, a marker ahead-right in the level is on the strip's right
ui-compass world_view: mirrored level with a georeference turned 90: the level's +X is north, and its +Y (W) is on the player's right
ui-compass world_view: world: the same markers unmirrored put E on the right and W on the left (the control for the mirrored strip)
ui-compass world_view: world: mirrored false is an unmirrored level
ui-compass world_view: world: refused, a mirrored that is not a boolean
